public_health_question.v: What are the initial characteristics, case counts and outcomes of the 2022 Sudan ebolavirus disease outbreak in Uganda?

ev.q: This report describes the fifth outbreak of EVD caused by Sudan ebolavirus in Uganda since 2000
Outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease Caused by Sudan ebolavirus — Uganda, August–October 2022
The response focuses on active case finding (initiated in Madudu and Butoloogo subcounties), tracing and monitoring contacts for EVD signs and symptoms
MoH, the Mubende District health team, and other partners launched a public health emergency response to identify additional cases of EVD.

equity.level_reason: Age and sex appear only as descriptors of cases and decedents; health care workers are an exposure route, not social position. No equity framing.

ev.q: the median patient age is 29 years (range = 1–70 years), 87 (59%) patients are men
the median age of decedents was 28 years (range = <1–58 years), and 31 (51%) were women

notes: Descriptive outbreak case series with an epidemic curve; no groups or periods are compared, so data_focus is limited. Design inferred as outbreak investigation from the response description. The 55% case fatality rate and the 2000 outbreak figures are cited from earlier reports.
